_comment: The lift the car in the bay goes up on (the parts view's lift button): with no model named, the game draws its own from boxes, an in-ground post with a saddle; a model of a mod's names its rising part lift_post, the top of its saddle at that node's origin. Its place says the garage has one and the floor's height there: the post stands under the middle of the car in the bay, whatever its position's x and z. A garage it has no place in still lifts the car, with no lift drawn.
name: Lift
